categories.description: Idiomatic wrappers of specific APIs for convenient access from Rust. Includes HTTP API wrappers as well. Non-idiomatic or unsafe bindings can be found in External FFI bindings.
Crates to help with allocation, memory mapping, garbage collection, reference counting, or interfaces to foreign memory managers.
